premises.text: The travel planning process is complicated by too many irrelevant sources and options.
premises.evidence_span: Millions of sources and services have made a smooth travel planning process impossible Too often we're stuck with content totally irrelevant to us and too many options leave us totally paralyzed

premises.text: Mapify integrates various travel services into a single platform.
premises.evidence_span: a platform like this not only unify all of these services? But actually curate the most relevant places and personal experiences for you

premises.text: Travelers can create and share visualizations of their travel journeys using Mapify.
premises.evidence_span: Mapify is your personal travel guide that lets you create your whole travel journey in just a few seconds

premises.text: Mapify uses an AI content engine to match travel experiences with user preferences.
premises.evidence_span: Everything you've just seen is based on an AI content engine we've built matching hundreds of thousands of tags

premises.text: The millennial leisure travel market is a significant segment worth around 150 billion dollars.
premises.evidence_span: The millennial leisure travel market is one of the largest travel market segments ever We're focusing on monetizing the European subsegment first worth around 150 billion dollars

value.text: Travel planning becomes easier and more personalized through Mapify.
